_doc: Semantic notes per table, given to the Planner and SQL agent. Domain documentation, not answers.
NY_TAXI.yellow_tripdata: NYC TLC yellow taxi trips, one row per trip. tpep_pickup_datetime is the event time; fare_amount/total_amount in USD; PULocationID/DOLocationID join NY_TAXI.taxi_zones.LocationID. Raw months contain a few out-of-range timestamps and negative fares (data-quality checks).
NY_TAXI.taxi_zones: TLC zone lookup: LocationID, Borough, Zone, service_zone (Airports, Yellow Zone, Boro Zone, EWR).
NOAA_GHCN_S3.noaa_ghcn_daily_2024: NOAA GHCN-Daily, long format: one row per station, day and element. ID=station (USW00094728 Central Park, USW00014732 LaGuardia, USW00094789 JFK), DATE=yyyymmdd integer, ELEMENT in PRCP (tenths of mm), SNOW (mm), SNWD (snow depth mm), TMAX/TMIN (tenths of deg C); DATA_VALUE holds the value. Always filter one station for city weather. In Zetaris a headerless CSV exposes columns as _c0.._c7 in this order.
HOLIDAYS.us_public_holidays_2024: US public holidays 2024 from Nager.Date. is_nationwide=false means state-only (check counties for US-NY).
